sections.title: New Features
items: StikDebug JIT integration for optimal performance on iOS 17.4+
Auto-enable JIT on launch with user control
Real-time JIT status monitoring with visual indicators
TXM detection for iOS 26+ with A13/A14/M1+ chips
RetroAchievements support with full achievement and leaderboard tracking
iOS 26 crash prevention with signal handlers

sections.title: Improvements
items: Enhanced JIT settings UI with color-coded status indicators
Context-aware help messages based on JIT state
Improved app lifecycle handling for background JIT restoration
Dual-mapped memory testing for modern iOS JIT
Better error messaging for JIT enablement issues

sections.title: Technical Changes
items: Migrated to StikDebug-only JIT approach (removed built-in mode)
Added Metal framework for chip detection
Implemented 500ms JIT polling for reactive UI
Added Security framework for entitlement checking
Updated to stikjit:// URL scheme with iOS 26 script support

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed unused variable warnings in NetPlayView
Fixed Swift compilation errors in JIT detection code

notes: JIT is recommended for smooth gameplay in most 3DS games
Install StikDebug and LocalDevVPN from GitHub for JIT support
Auto-enable JIT is ON by default for best out-of-box experience
